newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn to buy N.J. tower for $159 mln.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn to buy N.J. tower for $159 mln.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp on Tuesday said it will buy the one million square foot Newport Tower office building in Jersey City, New Jersey
The Toronto-based real estate company said the purchase price of the 37-story Class A tower is expected to be US$159 million and the transaction is expected to close in September.

With the Newport Tower purchase TrizecHahn said it will have completed acquisitions in 1997 valued at almost US$700 million. The purchases include the Grace Building in New York and Citicorp Center in Los Angeles.

TrizecHahn said the Newport tower is currently 98 percent leased to tenants such as First Chicago Trust Company and investment firm Brown Brothers Harriman. A number of leases are below current market rates and this offers the opportunity to increase cash flow as leases expire, TrizecHahn said.
